_about: Known parameters of the surviving Leibniz four-species stepped-drum machine (GWLB Hannover, 'younger machine'), compiled for 3D modelling. confidence: high = stated by a primary/engineering source and corroborated; medium = single reliable source; low = secondary/unverified or inferred. Source tags are defined in ../sources/bibliography.md.

result_digits.note: Leibniz's 1710 description and Jordan/Leupold figures show 12 result windows (older machine/description).

rib_lengths.value: graduated, digit 1 = full length ... digit 9 = shortest (drum shifts axially under fixed receiving gear)
rib_lengths.missing: absolute lengths, step increment, drum diameter

setting_method.value: knob on horizontal digit disc -> pinion -> rack slider -> axial shift of drum; drum driven through sliding gear on a long gear

diameter_mm.how_to_get: Lehmann drawings NL 183/465, Stein&Kopp 2010, or photo-scaling from 37 mm digit pitch

display.value: vertical digit discs (horizontal axes) behind rectangular windows on top of Pars immobilis

detent.value: holding springs + detent-notch wheels (Rastkerbenräder), 18 deg notch pitch on carry storage axis

digit_pitch_mm.source: BURKHARDT1897 (carriage screw pitch 37 mm = one decimal place)
digit_pitch_mm.note: inference: screw pitch equals digit spacing because one screw turn shifts carriage one place

principle.value: two-phase: phase 1 parallel digit addition with carries stored (Einzahn turns Fünfhorn/Muldenrad 18 deg); phase 2 serial carry execution by staggered Zweihorn levers during rib-free drum sector, lowest digit first, cascading secondary carries

parts: Einzahn (EZ, single tooth on sum-wheel shaft)
Zweihorn (ZH, two-horned drive lever; one horn per direction)

zweihorn_spread_dresden_deg.note: Order as printed under Bild 3; mapping to digit index and to add/subtract horn not stated explicitly. Gap of 36 deg between H4 and H5; H5 spread +3 deg vs H4.

hannover_model_optimisation.value: spread delta-phi 31.5 deg; drum pitch 21 deg; +87 deg extra crank to finish carries

layout.value: gear chain Z1..Z17 along carriage driven by crank; alternating drum-drive gears and carry-lever (H_i) gears

operation_per_crank_turn.value: one addition (one direction) or subtraction (other direction)

actuator.value: crank at left end turning a lead screw

positions.value: 16-8+1 = 9 alignments of the 8-digit carriage on the 16-digit register

rings.value: outer digits 0-9 (multiplication, black), inner rotating ring with holes, third ring digits (division/subtraction, red)

stop.value: fixed stop between 0 and 9 at top

handle.value: handle on the big wheel = main operation crank

known_unknowns: Absolute dimensions of every part (drum diameter/length, rib step, gear modules and tooth counts, shaft spacings, heights of the two decks)
Exact phase relationships (crank angle at which each drum rib and each Zweihorn engages) for the original as opposed to replicas
Tooth profiles (historic, not involute) and the shape of the Fünfhorn/Muldenrad/Zweihorn
Decorative casing details (engraving on Magna Rota, end frames) - photographs exist
